vo.text: Hiroo Onoda was hiding in the jungle on Lubang Island, in the Philippines.
vo.cap: Hiroo Onoda. The jungle of *Lubang Island.*

vo.text: Leaflets told him Japan had surrendered. He thought it was enemy propaganda.
vo.cap: Leaflets: *the war is over.* He thought it was *propaganda.*

vo.text: He held out for twenty-eight years and six months.
vo.cap: He held out for *28 years, 6 months.*

vo.text: In 1974, a young Japanese adventurer found him. Onoda still refused to surrender.
vo.cap: *1974:* an adventurer found him. He *still refused.*

vo.text: Only when his old commander flew in and relieved him of duty, did he finally give up.
vo.cap: Only his *old commander* could end it. He flew in... and relieved him of duty.
